# ColorEntry

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Model` in assembly `Nfty.Ticket`.

```csharp
public record ColorEntry
```

One weighted color option. Exactly one of [`ColorEntry.Range`](Nfty.Core.Model.ColorEntry.md#p-range) or [`ColorEntry.Fixed`](Nfty.Core.Model.ColorEntry.md#p-fixed) is set.

## Constructors

### ColorEntry(double, ColorRange?, string?) { #m-ctor-system-double-nfty-core-model-colorrange-system-string }

```csharp
public ColorEntry(double Weight, ColorRange? Range, string? Fixed);
```

**Parameters**

- `Weight` (`double`) - Relative weight against the other entries. Zero shelves the entry.
- `Range` (`ColorRange?`) - The band to roll within, or null when this entry is a fixed color.
- `Fixed` (`string?`) - A prefixed color spec (`hex:`, `rgb:`, `hsl:`, `hsv:`), or null when this entry is a range. A missing or unknown prefix is a validation error, never a guess.
